appName: Buff Pilot - Immersive VR Robot Control
displayName: Buff Pilot - Immersive VR Robot Control
display_name: Buff Pilot - Immersive VR Robot Control
display_long_description:
Buff Pilot turns your TEMI robot into an immersive work tool, letting you take on a new profession in VR. It provides opportunities for people with physical limitations (elderly, disabled) to perform productive non-face-to-face work.

Experience the scene from the robot's perspective with intuitive Meta Quest controls and head tracking to perform real-world tasks.

📌 Key Features
— Immersive VR Piloting Precisely control the robot's movement and gaze with Quest controllers and head tracking for a supreme sense of presence.
— Versatile Remote Work Conduct remote tasks like customer service, counseling, facility guidance, product promotion, interpretation, and security patrols via HD video calls.
— AI Hybrid Operation Use automatic mode for simple tasks and pilot-controlled hybrid mode for complex situations.
— Content Sharing Share YouTube videos, images, and music in real-time with customers through the robot.
— Rich Interaction Use emoji expressions and voice modulation for more engaging customer interactions.
— Simple Robot Pairing Easily add and manage robots with a simple QR code scan.

📌 [Required Apps]
— Controller App (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=kr.bluevisor.remote_control_avatar_client
— Robot App (temi): https://market.robotemi.com/details/pilot-temi-remote-controller

📌 [Requirements]
— A TEMI robot and a stable network connection are required.
— The receiver app must be installed on the robot from the TEMI Market.
